summary: Write 'Ansible', not 'Ansible, Inc.' or 'AnsibleWorks' except in legal or financial text, never use the logotype in body text, and treat the company as 'it'.
questions: Should I write Ansible, Inc. in docs?
Is Ansible referred to as 'it' or 'they'?

answer_card.title: Referring to Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: Write **Ansible** (not "Ansible, Inc." or "AnsibleWorks") except in legal/financial statements. Don't use the logotype in body text. The company is singular: "it", not "they".
